prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw the actual large seated cliff Buddha of Dapi Mountain 大伾山大石佛 in Xun County, Henan, from photo2. This plate intentionally shows the photographed VISIBLE UPPER BODY, from the full head and hair curls down to both knees and the lap; do not invent legs or feet outside this framing. Keep its broad upright torso, long ears, very large right hand held palm-out beside the chest (on the viewer LEFT), left hand resting on the left knee (viewer RIGHT), broad rounded knees and sparse heavy robe folds. Its face is broad and grave, longer and more rectangular than the style master, with characteristic hollow damaged chin and worn neck. Preserve that chin damage as a few clear irregular outline contours, and the main surviving surface losses at chest/neck, rather than giving it a new smooth ideal face. Do not use the Vairocana master anatomy; it is only the delicate line style reference. Correct extreme upward photographic perspective gently while retaining the actual Buddha proportions. Remove all shelter walls, roof beams, paint color, rough stone texture, shadows and background. Isolate the visible bust-and-knees silhouette with a few graceful major robe contours on white; no dark paint patches, tiny cracks, hatching or stippling. Portrait1024x1536, leave generous margin around entire visible image, taper the lower drapery contour softly above bottom margin like the master, no words or frame.

site_recommendation.name: 大伾山摩崖大佛
site_recommendation.sub: 依崖而坐的浚县大石佛
site_recommendation.yearNote: 断代有后赵、北齐等说。此处560仅按文物出版社2004年资料所载北齐始凿说作排序点，不表示确定始凿年；2026年河南日报文保现场报道采用后赵说。保留分歧，勿解读为已定北齐。
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: Commons遗产群公开点位（35°39′46.76″N114°33′24.34″E）近似定位，非大佛测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 大伾山大佛依山崖凿就，右手上举、左手抚膝。开凿年代存在后赵、北齐等不同判断，现存表层又叠加了后世修补与彩绘。

facts.label: 断代有异
facts.text: 旧文保资料记北齐始凿、唐初完成；近期保护报道采用后赵说，本条保留不同判断。

facts.label: 依崖巨像
facts.text: 造像为倚坐姿态，右手施无畏印，左手置膝；图版仅画照片中头部至双膝可见部分。

facts.label: 保护现状
facts.text: 明正统十年曾修缮；2025年启动新一轮本体保护，线稿依据2024年修缮前实拍。
